page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.16xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated instance from the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on x86_64 architecture and virtualized using KVM, it is driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. The instance delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs accompanied by 376.0 GB of system RAM, allocating roughly 5.88 GB of memory per core. Compute and parallel graphic processing capabilities are augmented by two onboard NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a combined 48 GB of video memory.

Hardware storage is absent on the host, meaning local NVMe or SSD capacity is zero. Persistent volumes, operating system filesystems, and temporary dataset caches must be provisioned through remote network-attached disks. To support network storage overhead and high-volume data ingest, the instance is equipped with a 32 Gbps baseline network throughput.

The dense pairing of 64 dedicated CPU cores and dual NVIDIA A10 accelerators provides balanced efficiency for GPU-accelerated computing pipelines without the resource cost of top-tier multi-GPU training nodes. Primary workload fits include deep learning inference, cloud rendering, computer-aided engineering simulations, video encoding, and high-throughput data processing workflows.

With balanced memory density and dual enterprise accelerators, this instance suits workloads such as machine learning inference, video processing, computer graphics rendering, and concurrent scientific simulation pipelines requiring sustained compute capability.
